evals.prompt: Find up to 5 Toyota ads in Riyadh posted within the last week on Haraj. Give me a concise Markdown comparison with listing ID, price, city, tags, and source URL.
evals.expected_output: Executes `haraj search` with the Toyota keyword, Riyadh and one-week filters, limit 5, and --json; then compares at most five normalized results with IDs, SAR prices, tags, and canonical URLs.
expectations: The Markdown comparison contains no more than five listings and includes ID, price, city, tags, and canonical Haraj URL for each.
The command evidence uses `haraj search` with `--city الرياض`, `--during-date 1week`, `--limit 5`, and `--json`.
The response identifies the results as marketplace data that is not independently verified.

evals.prompt: Search Haraj ads whose body text says 'الممشى: 322,000 كم'. Return up to 3 matches as JSON and explain whether that is an exhaustive Haraj-wide body-text search.
evals.expected_output: Runs `haraj search --body-text` with limit 3 and --json, returns only matching normalized results, and correctly describes the client-side candidate filtering limitation.
expectations: The command evidence uses `haraj search --body-text "الممشى: 322,000 كم" --limit 3 --json` or an equivalent quoted command.
The returned JSON is an array with no more than three normalized listings, each with bodyText containing the requested phrase after whitespace normalization.
The response states that the filter checks bodyText within Haraj search candidates and does not promise exhaustive database-wide matching.

evals.prompt: Look up Haraj post 187108979 and summarize its normalized details. Include its images and canonical URL, but do not repeat contact information from the ad text.
evals.expected_output: Uses `haraj get 187108979 --json` and summarizes only normalized fields, including image URLs and the canonical URL, while not reproducing contact details from bodyText.
expectations: The response includes the post ID, title, price, city, district, tags, image URLs, source, retrieval timestamp, and canonical URL.
The response does not reproduce a telephone number or other direct contact detail from bodyText.
The response clearly identifies the listing as marketplace-provided information that is not independently verified.
